explication: Frappe Suite is a single Frappe workspace for seven productivity products. Users enter through the shared workspace and use Drive, Writer, Sheets, Slides, Meet, Mail, and Calendar for file, content, meeting, and communication workflows. The README documents shared Frappe services, Yjs collaboration in Writer and Sheets, Hocuspocus for Sheets, and mediasoup for Meet. Several subsystems are represented by their exact enclosing directories because their implementation files were not sampled; the graph omits unverified internal call paths.
